summary: Full frontend verification of the 3 new dashboard features (Προσαρμογή Αρχικής, Σύγκριση Περιόδων, Πρόβλεψη Ρευστότητας) as owner and accountant. All acceptance criteria pass. KPI period-comparison maths verified against demo values: net 2.610,00 € vs prev 5.669,00 € = -54% (green→red logic correct, badge red with TrendingDown); VAT 626,40 € vs 766,08 € = -18,2%; collections 6.219,48 € vs 917,60 € = +577,8% (green + TrendingUp); Ληξιπρόθεσμα card correctly has NO badge. Cashflow forecast widget (data-testid=cashflow-forecast-card) present with all 4 figures and math check: 7.633,08 + 17.904,08 − 465,22 = 25.071,94 € (matches 'Πρόβλεψη σε 90 ημέρες'). Underlying data has 13 weekly points (verified in /app/frontend/src/lib/services/cashflow.ts loop `w<13`); the chart axis visibly shows 7 labels (Recharts auto-decimation every 2 weeks — acceptable). data-testid=cashflow-lowest renders 'Χαμηλότερο σημείο ταμείου: 8.067,08 € την εβδομάδα 12/09.' 'Αναλυτικά' link → /reports/cashflow renders (h1 'Ταμειακή ρευστότητα · 90 ημέρες'). Customisation dialog lists all 10 widgets numbered 1–10 with the exact labels from DASHBOARD_WIDGETS. Turning OFF widget-toggle-top + widget-toggle-subs and saving fires toast 'Η αρχική σελίδα ενημερώθηκε.' and both widgets disappear; state PERSISTS across page reload AND navigation to /invoices and back. Reordering: widget-up-forecast moved forecast above chart12m, visually confirmed. reset-dashboard-btn + save restores defaults. Per-user isolation VERIFIED: owner hid top+subs; accountant logistis@timologio.gr sees the DEFAULT layout with top+subs visible AND retains a working customize-dashboard-btn (personal-preference model correct for read-only role). Responsive @390/768/1280/1920: scrollWidth == clientWidth on all four; @390 the customize dialog is scrollable (sh=825 > ch=717, overflow-y auto) and all 10 rows reachable. Regression smoke: /invoices 200, /recurring 200, /settings 200, /portal/<token> 200 (renders 'Σελίδα πελάτη' with balance 620,00 €). Owner dashboard prefs LEFT RESET TO DEFAULTS at end of run as requested.

formatting_issues.issue: KPI #1 badge renders '-54%' (no decimal) while KPI #2 renders '-18,2%'. The math is correct (Math.round yields exactly -54.0, and Intl formats -54.0 as '-54'), but for visual consistency across all three delta badges consider forcing minimumFractionDigits:1 so it always reads '-54,0%'. LOW priority — not part of a strict spec requirement (spec asks 'rounded to 1 decimal' which is satisfied numerically).

verified_fixes: KPI period comparison: -54% / -18,2% / +577,8% badges with correct up/down arrows and colour (green for ≥0, red for <0); 4th card has no badge; each badge line shows 'Προηγούμενος μήνας: X €' as required.

Cashflow forecast card: 4 figures + math (Διαθέσιμο 7.633,08 + Εισπράξεις 17.904,08 − Πληρωμές 465,22 = Πρόβλεψη 25.071,94 €), 13 data points in service, 7 auto-decimated x-axis labels visible, cashflow-lowest line correct, 'Αναλυτικά' → /reports/cashflow renders.

Cross-check numbers: /reports 'Σύνολο ανεξόφλητων' = 2.430,40 €. Cashflow 'Αναμενόμενες εισπράξεις' = 17.904,08 € legitimately exceeds it (includes 90-day-due invoices + expected subscription invoices per service logic).
Customize dialog: 10 numbered widgets, labels match DASHBOARD_WIDGETS, hide+save persists across reload and cross-page navigation (stored in memberships.dashboard_prefs_json).
Toast 'Η αρχική σελίδα ενημερώθηκε.' shown on save.
Reordering via widget-up-forecast moves widget in visual order; reset-dashboard-btn + save restores default order+visibility.
Per-user isolation: owner-level hidden widgets do NOT affect accountant; accountant (read-only) can still open Προσαρμογή.
Responsive at 390/768/1280/1920: no horizontal overflow; dialog scrollable at 390.
Regression smoke: /invoices, /recurring, /settings, /portal/<token> all 200 and render expected content.
action_items: (LOW / optional) Consider minimumFractionDigits:1 in the KPI delta formatter (dashboard/page.tsx) so '-54%' becomes '-54,0%' for consistency with '-18,2%' and '+577,8%'.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard/page.tsx line ~73: `const prev = ...;  const delta = ...` — two statements on the same physical line after a `;`. Works, but reduces readability. Consider splitting into two lines.

cashflow-forecast-card 'Χαμηλότερο σημείο ταμείου' currently always chooses points[0] when tied (reduce with < comparison and initial=points[0]); acceptable for the demo, but if week 0 is negative and later weeks are also negative but lower, the current code correctly picks the min — no bug, just noting the ordering guarantee.

cashflowForecast90: x-axis in the card visually shows only 7 of the 13 labels due to Recharts auto-tick spacing. If the spec strictly wants 13 visible dd/MM labels, set XAxis `interval={0}` and rotate labels; otherwise this is fine.
